page: Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is an isolated, memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Edsv7 server family. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, this instance features 372 dedicated vCPUs and is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is designed for workloads requiring massive memory footprints and high-capacity local storage.

The hardware configuration delivers 2832.0 GB of system memory, translating to approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per virtual core. Additionally, the instance is equipped with 22,677 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk operations. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E372ids_v7 offers a highly dense resource profile, consolidating massive compute, memory, and local storage capacities into a single isolated instance. This density reduces the need for multi-node clustering for large-scale workloads, though the lack of GPU acceleration limits its utility for hardware-accelerated deep learning.

This instance is suited for memory-intensive and data-heavy workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale relational databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and extensive data warehousing operations that benefit from isolated compute environments and high-capacity local storage.
